description: D-340 pressure fixture — the shared algorithm nobody labeled core. A deliberately boring middle hop: ghost.load@1 calls echo.ping@1 through its granted capability and returns the amplified result. When a swarm of plugins holds port:ghost.load@1, kernel.centrality@1 must surface THIS plugin's op as load-bearing purely from computed fan-in (requirement #7: computed, never assigned).

capabilities.justification: The middle hop of the plugins-of-plugins chain (fan → load → echo): pressure fixture for inter-compartment calls through the kernel graph.
